title: MediaGallery
description: Fiori image and video gallery with measured thumbnail overflow, selectable items, keyboard navigation, responsive layouts, and a phone carousel (ui5-media-gallery).

usage.summary: Browse images and videos by selecting thumbnails and inspecting the selected media.
useWhen: Let users choose an image or video thumbnail and inspect the corresponding item in a display area.
Keep alternative views of the same object together, with responsive thumbnail placement and overflow access.
Compose MediaGalleryItem children with thumbnails; use interactiveDisplayArea when pressing the selected media opens a detailed view.

avoidWhen.when: Browse generic content pages in sequence without thumbnail selection.
Show one identity photo, initials or placeholder for a person or entity.
Manage attached files with upload status, deletion, retry or termination.
